meta.title: Helper Training in Hong Kong: 9 Weeks That Change How Your Child Is Cared For
meta.description: My Best Auntie is Hong Kong's Montessori-based domestic helper training programme. Three small-group sessions, three home visits and three parent calls over 9 weeks. See upcoming cohorts, pricing and book online.

socialImage.alt: My Best Auntie helper training in Hong Kong

hero.subtitle: Montessori-based domestic helper training: group sessions, coaching in your home and parent calls, in one 9-week programme.
hero.description: Your helper spends more waking hours with your child than anyone else. In 9 weeks she learns practical Montessori skills for meals, play, transitions and independence, in your home and with your routines. No prior experience needed.
hero.imageAlt: Ida De Gregorio from Evolve Sprouts

description.title: Everything your helper needs to make it stick
description.description: Group learning builds the knowledge. Private coaching in your home makes it work with your child, your routines and your space.

items.title: 3 small-group training sessions
items.description: Live sessions exclusively for helpers. Child development, gentle guidance and independence, taught in a respectful space without employer pressure.

items.title: 3 private home visits
items.description: I observe your helper with your child inside your real routines, align expectations, adjust responses and coach precise language on the spot.

items.title: 3 parent strategy calls
items.description: We step back, assess progress and realign. You know what is working, what needs adjusting, and how to stop small issues becoming long-term patterns.

items.title: Scripts, tools and real-life examples
items.description: Ready-to-use language for tantrums, meal refusal, bedtime battles and screen meltdowns. Guide without shouting, redirect without punishment.

items.title: WhatsApp support for helpers and parents
items.description: A private community for enrolled helpers plus direct access for parents between sessions, so consistency does not collapse under daily pressure.

items.title: Written reports after every visit
items.description: Clear summaries with observations, focus areas and immediate next steps, plus a final report with recommendations for the next stage.

items.title: Who it's for
items.description: Families in Hong Kong with a child aged 0-6 and a domestic helper who looks after them day to day. Pick your child's age group in the booking panel to see matching cohorts.

items.title: Format and timing
items.description: 9 weeks in three blocks: set up the home, gentle guidance and boundaries, then fostering independence. Each block has one group session, one home visit and one parent call.

items.title: Language
items.description: Sessions are in English with demonstrations, visual guidance and repetition. Fluent English is not required. Message me on WhatsApp if you have a question about language.

items.title: Price and payment
items.description: The price for each cohort is shown in the booking panel. Reserve your seat and pay securely online in one step; you receive a confirmation email straight away.

items.title: Not sure yet?
items.description: Use the WhatsApp button at the top of this page. Tell me about your child and your helper and I will tell you honestly whether this programme is the right fit.

items.question: Is the programme suitable for helpers with no childcare experience?
items.answer: Yes. My Best Auntie is designed for all experience levels. No Montessori knowledge or prior childcare training is required, just a willingness to learn.

items.question: How is this different from a standard helper training course?
items.answer: Unlike generic helper training, My Best Auntie is Montessori-based with home visits, personalised coaching and ongoing support. We observe your helper with your child in your home and give specific, actionable guidance, not just classroom theory.

items.question: How long is the programme?
items.answer: 9 weeks, with three group training sessions, three home visits and three parent alignment calls. It is designed to create lasting behavioural change, not a one-off lecture.

items.question: Can my helper join if she speaks limited English?
items.answer: Yes. The training uses clear language, demonstrations, visual guidance and repetition. Fluent English is not required. Understanding and consistency are what matter.

items.question: What will my child gain?
items.answer: Your child's caregiver learns practical Montessori techniques for daily routines, gentle discipline without threats or bribes, age-appropriate activities for 0-6 and how to foster independence in a small Hong Kong home. Your child builds confidence, emotional regulation and real skills through everyday moments.

items.question: What if my helper and I disagree on discipline?
items.answer: This is very common. We align the adults first so your child receives consistent messages, expectations and routines from everyone at home.

items.question: Do you guarantee results?
items.answer: Children are not machines, so no ethical professional guarantees instant perfection. What I do guarantee is clear guidance, practical strategy and honest support throughout the 9 weeks.

meta.title: 香港家政助手培训：改变孩子每日被照顾方式的 9 周课程
meta.description: My Best Auntie 是香港以蒙特梭利为基础的家政助手培训课程。9 周内包含三节小组课、三次家访和三次家长通话。查看近期开课日期与价格，并在线报名。

socialImage.alt: My Best Auntie 香港家政助手培训

hero.subtitle: 以蒙特梭利为基础的家政助手培训：小组课、上门指导与家长通话，尽在一个 9 周课程。
hero.description: 你的阿姨和孩子在一起的时间比任何人都长。9 周内，她会在你家中、按你的日常流程，学会用餐、游戏、过渡与独立的实用蒙特梭利技能。无需任何经验基础。
hero.imageAlt: Evolve Sprouts 的 Ida De Gregorio

quickFactChips.label: AMI 蒙特梭利认证导师

description.title: 让方法真正落地所需的一切
description.description: 小组学习建立知识，私人上门指导让方法在你家、你的日常和你的空间里真正发挥作用。

items.title: 3 节小组培训课
items.description: 仅面向阿姨的线下课程。在被尊重、没有雇主压力的空间里，学习儿童发展、温和引导与独立能力培养。

items.title: 3 次私人家访
items.description: 我会在你家真实的日常中观察阿姨与孩子的互动，对齐期待、调整回应，并当场示范精准表达。

items.title: 3 次家长策略通话
items.description: 我们会退一步评估进展并重新校准方向。你会清楚知道什么有效、什么需要调整，以及如何避免小问题演变为长期模式。

items.title: 话术、工具与真实案例
items.description: 可直接使用的话术，应对发脾气、拒绝进食、睡前拉锯和屏幕崩溃。不靠吼叫也能引导，不靠惩罚也能转移。

items.title: 阿姨与家长的 WhatsApp 支持
items.description: 面向已报名阿姨的私密社群，以及家长在课与课之间的直接提问渠道，让一致性不在日常压力下崩塌。

items.title: 每次到访后的书面报告
items.description: 清晰的总结，包括观察要点、聚焦方向和可立即执行的下一步，并在课程结束时提供含后续建议的总结报告。

items.title: 适合对象
items.description: 居住在香港、有 0-6 岁孩子且由家政助手日常照顾的家庭。在报名面板中选择孩子的年龄组，即可查看对应的开课班次。

items.title: 形式与时间
items.description: 9 周分为三个阶段：布置家居环境、温和引导与界限、培养独立。每个阶段包含一节小组课、一次家访和一次家长通话。

items.title: 语言
items.description: 课程以英语进行，并配合示范、视觉引导与重复练习。流利英语并非必须。如有语言方面的疑问，请在 WhatsApp 联系我。

items.title: 价格与付款
items.description: 每个班次的价格显示在报名面板中。一步完成预留席位与安全在线付款，并即时收到确认邮件。

items.title: 还在犹豫？
items.description: 点击页面顶部的 WhatsApp 按钮，告诉我你的孩子和阿姨的情况，我会如实告诉你这个课程是否适合你们。

items.question: 课程适合没有育儿经验的阿姨吗？
items.answer: 适合。My Best Auntie 面向所有经验水平的阿姨。无需蒙特梭利知识或之前的育儿培训经历，只需要愿意学习的心。

items.question: 这跟一般的阿姨培训课程有什么不同？
items.answer: 不同于普通的助手培训，My Best Auntie 以蒙特梭利为基础，包含家访、个性化辅导和持续支持。我们会在你家中观察阿姨与孩子的互动，提供具体可行的指导，而不只是课堂理论。

items.question: 课程有多长？
items.answer: 为期 9 周，包含三次小组培训、三次家访和三次家长沟通电话。课程旨在实现持久的行为改变，而非一次性讲座。

items.question: 如果我的阿姨英语不太好，可以参加吗？
items.answer: 可以。培训采用清晰的语言、示范、视觉引导和重复练习。流利的英语并非必须，理解和一致性才是关键。

items.question: 我的孩子能获得什么？
items.answer: 孩子的照护者将学到蒙特梭利日常实操技巧、不用威胁或贿赂的温和纪律方法、适合 0-6 岁的活动，以及如何在香港小户型中培养独立性。孩子会通过日常时刻建立自信、情绪调节和真正的技能。

items.question: 如果我和阿姨在纪律上意见不一致怎么办？
items.answer: 这非常常见。我们会先帮助成人达成一致，让孩子从家中每个人那里接收到同一套信息、期待与日常规律。

items.question: 你们能保证结果吗？
items.answer: 孩子不是机器，没有任何负责任的专业人士会承诺立刻完美见效。我保证的是在这 9 周里提供清晰建议、务实策略和真诚支持。

items.title: 每次到訪後嘅書面報告

items.title: 適合對象

items.title: 價錢同付款

items.question: 課程適合無育兒經驗嘅姨姨嗎？

items.question: 同一般嘅姨姨培訓課程有咩分別？
items.answer: 不同於一般嘅姨姨培訓，My Best Auntie 以蒙特梭利為基礎，包含家訪、個人化輔導同持續支援。我哋會喺你屋企觀察姨姨同孩子嘅互動，提供具體可行嘅指導，而唔只係課堂理論。

items.question: 課程有幾長？

items.question: 如果我嘅姨姨英文唔太好，可以參加嗎？

items.question: 我嘅孩子能獲得啲咩？

items.question: 如果我同姨姨喺管教上意見不一致點算？
items.answer: 呢個好常見。我哋會先協助成人對齊，令孩子從屋企每一個人度接收到一致嘅訊號、期望同日常規律。

items.question: 你哋會保證結果嗎？
